metadata.case_name: LAM PO YUK AND ANOTHER v. MERCURY SHIPPING CO LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: an electrician employed by the defendant to work on board the M. V. "Acacia"

source: On 18th August, 1989, upon echography, the deceased was found to have splenic contusion with suspicions about the pancreas, and a splenectomy was performed.

injuries.description: Removal of part of the pancreas and the gall bladder
source: On 26th August, 1989, the deceased had a second operation to remove part of the pancreas and the gall bladder.

injuries.description: Direct traumatism of the left hypocondrium
injuries.body_part: left hypocondrium (left lateral regions in the upper zone of the abdomen, below the level of the floating ribs)
source: According to the medical reports, the deceased had sustained direct traumatism of the left hypocondrium, ie, the left lateral regions in the upper zone of the abdomen, below the level of the floating ribs.
Later, the deceased was found to suffer occlusive sydrome.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified blood vessel at abdomen, lower back or pelvis level

injuries.description: Gastro-intestinal bleeding from duodenal ulcer (cause of death)
source: The cause of death on the post-mortem examination report was recorded as "gastro-intestinal bleeding from duodenal ulcer."

manifestations.description: The deceased's condition did not improve and his digestive system deteriorated further
A pleural effusion appeared on the left side
The deceased was depressed whilst hospitalized
Conscious from the time of the accident until his death nearly six weeks later

treatments_received: admitted to the Gabriel Martin Hospital in St. Paul, Reunion
second operation to remove part of the pancreas and the gall bladder
transferred to Queen Mary Hospital for further treatment

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan kin fu v. Lee kam hung
comparable_cases.injury_description: ruptured spleen, undergoing an emergency laparotomy and splenectomy, and being hospitalised for one week.
